_comment: TfNSW published on-time running by contract, from the 'Buses - On-time Running' dataset on the TfNSW Open Data Hub. Update published_period and the published_on_time values when a newer month comes out. agencies = GTFS agency IDs (the part of route_id before '_') belonging to each contract; Transit Systems is left unmatched because its two agency groups can't be tied to contracts unambiguously.
